howto.p1.title: Move & look
howto.p1.pc: Move with WASD, jump with Space. Click the screen to lock the mouse and aim.
howto.p1.touch: Drag the left side to move. Drag the right side (or the FIRE button) to aim.
howto.p2.title: Shoot ink, paint the cube
howto.p2.pc: Hold Left click to fire ink. Walls, floor and ceiling all count. Your own ink makes you faster.
howto.p2.touch: Hold FIRE to shoot ink. Walls, floor and ceiling all count. Your own ink makes you faster.
howto.p3.title: Flip gravity
howto.p3.pc: Aim at any surface and press Right click or Shift. That surface becomes the floor — and you fall onto it.
howto.p3.touch: Aim at any surface and press FLIP (or tap the surface). That surface becomes the floor — and you fall onto it.
howto.p4.title: Ink Stamp & Gravity Bomb
howto.p4.pc: Land hard after a long fall to INK STAMP — big splash, rivals underneath get inked. Paint to charge your Gravity Bomb and throw it with Q: it flips nearby rivals' gravity.
howto.p4.touch: Land hard after a long fall to INK STAMP — big splash, rivals underneath get inked. Paint to charge your Gravity Bomb and throw it with the bomb button.
howto.p5.title: Gravity Bomb Tag
howto.p5.pc: Holding the bomb? Touch someone to pass it before it blows. Flip gravity to escape, Left click to shove. Last one standing wins.
howto.p5.touch: Holding the bomb? Touch someone to pass it before it blows. Flip gravity to escape, press SHOVE to push. Last one standing wins.
